prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE NEW finished webcomic panel, not a poster, collage, split board or multiple panels. PORTRAIT image, requested 1024x1536.
Reference 1 is the original drawing/world benchmark. Reference 2 supplies only our newly inspected cast identities, clothing and equipment. Compose the completely new moment described below. Do not reproduce either reference's framing or add its absent characters.

Drawing treatment: Thin controlled anime contours, elegant facial planes when faces are visible, angular grouped hair shapes and precise tailored clothing contours. Luminous glass translucency where glass occurs, layered inhabited navy architecture, selective warm/cyan light. Preserve the original integrated night atmosphere and depth through broad value groups. These are drawing qualities, not instructions to insert a person, creature or object absent from this shot.
World context: Layered vertical city at blue night. Upper admission gate on RIGHT, maintenance lift below LEFT side of same bridge, thick black metal anchor posts. Warm human windows, distant hanging gardens.
VISIBLE subjects in this panel ONLY:
Aren Vale: Light-skinned adult man, slim athletic build, narrow appealing face, gray eyes, swept midnight hair. Tailored ivory waist-length jacket WITH long sleeves over fitted black high-neck top, black slim trousers, plain boots and one red courier cord. Closer to original full Nightglass elegance; distinct provisional adaptation, not automatic original cast selection. Equipment: One solid silver crescent-edge short sword with black straight hilt and cyan pommel ring, anatomically RIGHT-handed when drawn. One flat sealed cream dispatch wallet. Do not assume either is in his hand or on his belt: the exact current inventory below controls position and possession.
Pell: Light-skinned older man with short gray hair, stubble, mustard maintenance jacket and charcoal trousers, broad work harness. Equipment: Plain body harness WORN around torso. Its separate safety tether and rail attachment follow current state. No external rig or extra pole.
Glass ray: Single immense navy translucent glass-wing ray, broad crescent wings, cyan circular sensory lights, narrow central beak, one long tail. Living alien animal; no humanoid face. Equipment: none
Inspected reference qualification for visible subjects only: Pell wears only his mustard jacket and body harness; omit the tall external rig beside him in the sheet.
Visibility/cropping constraints: Only the subjects above, framed as specified below.
ONE current moment: Pell’s car hangs tilted below the walkway. Aren turns away from the gate toward his shout.
Current physical state (authoritative): Single taut suspension cable holds lift; Pell still harnessed; Aren on bridge above.
Special visual element, only if specified: none
Camera and framing: Wide vertical geography: Aren upper right, car lower left, ray outside car. Respect actual subject-to-frame size, especially extreme wides. Do not enlarge a distant person into a medium shot.
Reserve the upper 25% of the image as calm, broad in-world background for later speech balloons. Keep ALL faces, hands, important contact and clue details BELOW that zone. Do not draw balloons or text; the blank space will receive editable lettering.
Draw acting with a specific expression and body intention. For contact, show the physical source/contact/target and its immediate reaction. For a clasp or weapon, make shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand-object ownership legible. Keep supports, scale and visible limb anatomy sound. Do not add later injuries, additional duplicates, alternate weapons, generic glows or undescribed consequences.
Surface design: matte quiet ground, broad deliberate light and shadow shapes, selective purposeful architecture. Group foliage, hair and material marks. Keep medium-defining directional ink/brushwork; avoid pervasive microtexture, repeated tiny facets, flooring crack networks, mirror floors and reflection glitter. Preserve richness through faces, composition and world depth.
No text of any kind, no speech balloons, no glyphs, no captions, no SFX lettering, no UI, no signatures, no watermark, no frame. Exact dialogue will be added separately. Return only the new artwork.
INVENTORY CONTINUITY — This is state information, not a request to add people. Only Aren Vale, Pell, Glass ray may appear physically, with the stated crop. Keep Sera Voss physically OUTSIDE this frame even if named in possession history. The existing action, camera and explicit nonphysical special elements control what is visible.
Aren sword sheathed at RIGHT hip; both hands free unless handling wallet. One sealed cream dispatch wallet belongs to Aren, on belt unless held in the specified action. Sera has no wallet yet. Jacket fully intact, no tears. No active cyan tether. Do not copy a line from later panels or anchor art. Pell wears body harness; a separate safety tether remains clipped to lift rail. The maintenance car remains attached to its suspension cable.
COMPOSITION FOR EDITABLE DIALOGUE: Do not change action geometry merely to fit speaker order; identify each balloon after actual art using short attribution and deliberate tail routing. Offscreen voices stay offscreen.
FINAL SHOT PRIORITY: Wide vertical geography: Aren upper right, car lower left, ray outside car. Depict only this instant: Pell’s car hangs tilted below the walkway. Aren turns away from the gate toward his shout. No added text or panel division.
